title: 14agentbox Configuration
description: Project-specific networking, ports, compose dependencies, and environment configuration for 14agentbox development containers.

ports.description: Host-to-container port mappings passed to docker run as '-p <port>'. Formats: 'HOST_PORT:CONTAINER_PORT' or 'HOST_PORT:CONTAINER_PORT/PROTOCOL' (e.g. '8080:8080', '25565:25565', '19132:19132/udp').

network.description: Docker network to connect the container to via '--network'. The runner creates it automatically if it does not already exist.

compose_services.description: Services from the project's docker-compose.yml to automatically start (docker compose up -d) before launching the container, and tear down when the container exits.

forward_ports.description: Intra-container port forward rules started via socat inside the container on 127.0.0.1. Format: 'SRC_PORT:TARGET_HOST:TARGET_PORT'.

links.description: Docker container links passed to docker run via '--link'. Format: 'CONTAINER_NAME:ALIAS'.

extra_hosts.description: Custom host-to-IP mappings added to /etc/hosts via '--add-host'. Format: 'HOSTNAME:IP'.

env.description: Environment variables passed into the container as '-e KEY=VALUE'.
